detail.longDescription: Dating apps such as Bumble forced to adapt as ‘swipe fatigue’ grows. Bumble was supposed to be different. When it launched in 2014, it offered women a simple proposition: if you matched with a man, you had to make the first move. This week, Bumble abandoned it. Source: The Guardian Technology https://www. theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2 026/aug/14/online-dating-salvage-mode--ai-bumble-app # AIAgents
